evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: The imperative directly commands the audience to erase specified knowledge, enacting a rank-based directive without a reciprocal or proportional exchange.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: The imperative commands comprehensive removal, performing unilateral authority rather than shared pooling or negotiated exchange.
